trade_setups.title: Pin / Mean-Reversion Frame
trade_setups.thesis: Heavy positive gamma near spot can dampen movement and favor range behavior.
trade_setups.risk: Break and acceptance outside the pin zone can invalidate the range setup.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPX 2026-04-20 Iron Condor: Buy 7115 Put / Sell 7125 Put / Sell 7130 Call / Buy 7140 Call (1-lot structure).

trade_setups.title: Upside Compression Toward Call Wall
trade_setups.thesis: Positive gamma above can attract price toward the next call concentration while compressing realized vol.
trade_setups.risk: Failure back below the reclaimed wall can trap upside continuation entries.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPX 2026-04-20 Call Debit Spread: Buy 7200 Call / Sell 7300 Call (1-lot structure).

trade_setups.title: Downside Expansion Through Put Wall
trade_setups.thesis: Negative gamma below can open a faster move toward the next downside pocket.
trade_setups.risk: Quick reclaim above the broken put wall can trigger short-covering and whipsaw.
trade_setups.exact_trade: SPX 2026-04-20 Put Debit Spread: Buy 6800 Put / Sell 6500 Put (1-lot structure).

trader_notes: Calls above 7200 and puts below 6800 define the nearest directional gates.
Spot is away from the gamma flip, so structural walls are the primary reference points.
Positive gamma dominates; range and spread structures are generally favored while key walls hold.
